summary: Tested dark/light mode theming fix for KPI and PPM in Pulse Pro. All features verified working: KPI cards have DARK backgrounds (#141414) with bright white text, PPM summary cards have dark backgrounds with colored values, Documents tab shows Upload button and General/Manuals/Invoices/Certificates category tabs with View/Download/Delete buttons per file.

backend_login_pulse_pro.details: POST /api/auth/login with lee.somers@pulsefitness.com / TempPass123! returns 200 with token

backend_kpi_dashboard.details: GET /api/reports/kpi-dashboard returns: 16 faults, 66 equipment, 20.04h avg downtime, 0% PPM compliance

backend_files_list.details: GET /api/files/list returns files for Lee Somers org (floor-plans, general categories)

backend_ppm_schedules.details: GET /api/ppm/schedules returns 0 schedules (expected - test schedules were created under admin)

backend_ppm_summary.details: GET /api/ppm/summary returns: 0 active, 0 upcoming, 0 completed, 0 overdue, 0% compliance

backend_ppm_checklists.details: GET /api/ppm/checklists returns equipment categories: Treadmill, X-Trainer, Stepper, U-Cycle/R-Cycle, L-Train

frontend_kpi_dark_theming.details: KPI summary cards have DARK backgrounds (#141414 = rgb(20,20,20)) with bright white text. NOT white cards.

frontend_kpi_detail_panels.details: PPM Compliance, Reactive Response Times, Safety & Inspection Compliance, Worst Performing Machines panels all have dark backgrounds

frontend_ppm_dark_theming.details: PPM summary cards have dark backgrounds (#141414) with colored values: blue (upcoming), green (completed), red (overdue)

frontend_ppm_schedule_cards.details: PPM schedule cards have dark backgrounds with white titles. Empty state shows 'No PPM schedules yet' message.

frontend_documents_upload_button.details: Upload Document button visible in Documents tab (blue button with upload icon)

frontend_documents_category_tabs.details: General/Manuals/Invoices/Certificates category tabs visible. General is default active tab with 13 files.

frontend_documents_file_actions.details: View/Download/Delete buttons visible per file (13 view, 13 download, 13 delete buttons found)

critical_code_review_comments: Dark theming fix correctly implemented - removed [data-portal='pulse'] CSS overrides that were turning cards white
KPI_THEME CSS uses .kpi-themed .kpi-card { background: #141414 !important } for consistent dark cards
PPM THEME_CSS uses .ppm-themed .ppm-card { background: #141414 !important } for consistent dark cards
Documents tab correctly defaults to General category (was previously defaulting to empty Manuals tab)
All file action buttons (View/Download/Delete) properly implemented with data-testid attributes
